say:2:1120635001:1.text: With the treasure finally in hand, the story reaches its greatest and most exciting chapter!
say:2:1120635001:1.source_cn: 终于到了打开宝箱的时刻，全故事的高光点，最激动人心的章节！

say:4:1120635002:1.text: Let me see... A compass, a shovel, some rope, and a pair of gloves...
say:4:1120635002:1.source_cn: 让我看看……指南针、铁锹、手套、绳索……

say:5:1120635003:1.text: These are just a treasure hunter's tools! Isn't there anything else in here?
say:5:1120635003:1.source_cn: 这些只是宝藏猎人的常用工具！还有没有其他的东西？

say:6:1120635004:1.text: There's also a small, leather-bound journal... Wait, this is father's handwriting! Let's see...
say:6:1120635004:1.source_cn: 还有一本小牛皮的笔记……等等，这是父亲的笔迹！让我看看……

say:9:1120635006:1.text: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.
say:9:1120635006:1.source_cn: 他经历了我们经历的一切，只是他……不像我们这么好运。
say:9:1120635006:1.male: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.
say:9:1120635006:1.female: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.

say:10:1120635007:1.text: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.
say:10:1120635007:1.source_cn: 匪徒盯上了他，抢走了他的寻宝手稿。他想方设法逃脱了，却...
say:10:1120635007:1.male: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.
say:10:1120635007:1.female: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.

say:11:1120635008:1.text: He didn't know about the scorpion antivenom. All he could do in this forsaken place was patch up his wound and keep walking.
say:11:1120635008:1.source_cn: 他没有解毒的知识，在这荒无人烟之地，只能简单处理伤口，...
say:11:1120635008:1.male: He didn't know about the scorpion antivenom. All he could do in this forsaken place was patch up his wound and keep walking.

say:14:1120635010:1.text: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.
say:14:1120635010:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，这确实是天意，是父亲的指引，让我们找到了他留下...
say:14:1120635010:1.male: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.
say:14:1120635010:1.female: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.

say:15:1120635011:1.text: It's a shame that we were too late.
say:15:1120635011:1.source_cn: 只可惜，我们来得晚了一些。
say:15:1120635011:1.male: It's a shame that we were too late.
say:15:1120635011:1.female: It's a shame that we were too late.

say:16:1120635012:1.text: "... I can feel my life ebbing away. The world is still so full of treasure waiting to be discovered, but unfortunately, my time is at its end."
say:16:1120635012:1.source_cn: “……我能感觉到生命在流逝，我相信还有尚未被发现的宝藏...

say:17:1120635013:1.text: "To my sons, Oldiler and Evan, please forgive me. I know I was never a good father. I failed to make a better life for you or even stay at your side..."
say:17:1120635013:1.source_cn: “对不起，我亲爱的欧迪尔和艾文，我不是个好父亲。没能给...

say:18:1120635014:1.text: "But if you treat life as one long treasure hunt, then the sights you see along the way... the singing birds in the trees, the sunset over the desert, the storms in distant seas... Perhaps those are the greatest treasures to discover."
say:18:1120635014:1.source_cn: “但……如果将生命看作一次寻宝，那些沿途的风景……丛林...

say:19:1120635015:1.text: "Nevertheless, I pray that you two will walk a different path. The way of the treasure hunter is fraught with danger and hardship. Even the worst father would not wish this life for his children."
say:19:1120635015:1.source_cn: “不过，我仍然希望欧迪尔和艾文不要走上这条路。这条路太...

say:20:1120635016:1.text: "With these last moments, I beseech the gods... Dura, the Dusk Lord, or whichever deity that watches over us..."
say:20:1120635016:1.source_cn: “最后……艾雅女神也好，残阳神也好，无论什么神灵都好……”

say:21:1120635017:1.source_cn: “请保佑艾文和欧迪尔能收到……”
